card.name: Punctuation after bradycardia in lists
card.fires_on: The comma, "or" or "and" right after "bradycardia" (or sinus arrest) in lists of cardiac conditions, mostly in beta-blocker contraindications and warnings. It anticipates a heart-related term such as heart block or heart failure next.

modes.label: Comma after bradycardia
modes.description: A comma following bradycardia in a contraindication or warning list, before heart block or similar terms.
modes.example: TRAINDICATIONS Hypertension and Angina Metoprolol tartrate tablets are contraindicated in sinus bradycardia<<,>> heart block greater than first degree, cardi

modes.label: Linking word after bradycardia
modes.description: "or" or "and" joining bradycardia to the next adverse effect.
modes.example: Concomitant use with negative chronotropes can increase the risk of bradycardia<< or>> hypotension [see Warnings and

card.writes: It promotes the word heart (and its Chinese equivalents), predicting heart block or heart failure next.
card.plain: It fires on the comma or "and" after bradycardia in a list, when a heart condition like heart block is likely to come next.
